label: preparing
what: A privately funded jubilee celebration, very likely for my forty years as mayor, is being prepared in the great hall for eighteen hundred. Baker and Builder are arranging bread supplies with secrecy requested until eighteen; Innkeeper is coordinating hall hospitality and Freight supplied money. The lighting inspection appears to provide the occasion or cover for my attendance. Secretary and Watchman know of the preparations and are respecting their discretion, though their active involvement in organizing is not established.
